subject: Insurance acceptance heuristics & COI delivery plan
messages:
From: Jared Levin <jared.levin@acme-corp.com>

Cc: contracts@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: COI and endorsement asks for Order Form

Olga —

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal ran a quick pass on the draft order form and asked us to confirm insurance deliverables before we push this through procurement. High level asks from Acme: 1) COI naming: "Acme Corp, its subsidiaries and affiliates" as Additional Insured (AI) on a primary & noncontributory basis; 2) Waiver of subrogation in favor of Acme; 3) Limits: General Liability $5M aggregate, $1M per occurrence; Cyber/PI $3M; E&O $3M; Workers comp per statutory.

Are these aligned with Redwood's standard MSA/order form? If there are required endorsement forms, can you share a sample and timeline to deliver? We attached our redline for reference.

Thanks — Jared

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Jared —

Appreciate the clear summary. Short answers up front: we can meet the AI naming and Waiver of Subrogation asks in most cases; the limits you list are higher than our standard SLAs for self-serve orders but consistent with an enterprise order, so we expect this to follow the order form escalation route (procurement + legal).

What I'll do now:
- Attach a marked-up MSA/Order Form with our suggested language for the Additional Insured endorsement and a checkbox for Primary/Noncontributory. (redline attached)
- Loop Legal (David) and Contract Ops (Kim) to confirm whether we require a carrier-issued endorsement vs. a COI with endorsement text.
- Propose an acceptance heuristic: if broker can issue a COI naming Acme + the issued endorsement PDF (or policy endorsement page) within 7 business days, we accept that for onboarding; otherwise we request a carrier endorsement and a 14-business-day remediation window.

Can you confirm the broker contact and whether Acme requires "blanket additional insured" (AI for every contract) or a single-entity naming? That affects whether we ask for a specific endorsement or an AI endorsement form.

Olga

Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: COI and endorsement asks for Order Form

Olga/Kim —

Thanks for the loop. High-level legal guidance and suggested endorsement language below. We aim to be pragmatic but preserve core protections. Notes: Acme's limits are reasonable for enterprise deals; we can map to a Dedicated/Enterprise order.

Suggested endorsement to request from carrier (or endorsement text acceptable as separate PDF):
"The endorsement extends Additional Insured status to: 'Acme Corp and its subsidiaries and affiliates' for liability arising out of the named insured's operations, products, and completed operations, on a primary and noncontributory basis. Carrier hereby waives rights of subrogation against Acme Corp to the extent permitted by law."

Acceptance heuristics (legal):
- Acceptable: Carrier-issued AI endorsement PDF OR COI plus endorsement text in a signed letter from the broker referencing the policy number and effective dates.
- Not acceptable: COI alone that lacks explicit endorsement language or reference to the policy endorsement ID.
- Timing: If Acme's broker can provide a carrier-issued endorsement within 7 business days, proceed with onboarding; otherwise document an exception and require remediation within 14 business days tied to the order's go-live.

Attachments: endorsement_sample_ACME.pdf (pdf) — sample endorsement we typically provide to carriers for reference.

I can draft a one-paragraph contract clause to insert in the order form that mirrors the endorsement language; happy to take that if helpful.

David Kim
Senior Counsel — Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Jared —

Thanks — summary and next steps below. We're aligned on the ask and have a clear acceptance path from Legal.

Plan: 1) Redwood will accept either: (A) carrier-issued AI endorsement PDF naming "Acme Corp and its subsidiaries and affiliates" + COI, OR (B) COI plus broker letter that references the specific policy endorsement ID and confirms primary/noncontributory and waiver of subrogation. 2) If the carrier can deliver endorsement PDF within 7 business days we will proceed to onboarding; otherwise we'll record a documented exception and expect remediation within 14 business days. 3) Igor at Acme (or your broker) please send the broker contact and preferred timeline — we'll route to our broker liaison to expedite.

I attached our redline and the sample endorsement David shared; I've also created a short checklist for contracts/procurement so nothing falls through.

Next steps for Acme: share broker contact + confirm whether you require AI as blanket or single-entity naming. We'll treat this as an enterprise order and route pricing/limits accordingly.

Olga
Director, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
